info.title: FlightLog Intelligence API
info.description: Upload, archive and analyse PX4 and ArduPilot flight logs.

post.summary:
Blocks sign-in and token refresh for the account. Access tokens already issued stay valid until they expire
(`Auth:AccessTokenMinutes`).

Queues an AI report of the flight's latest successful rule analysis (Engineer). Fails with
`ai.disabled` when AI analysis is off, `ai.already_pending` while one is running and
`ai.quota_exceeded` (429) when the team's daily limit is used up.

get.summary: AI analyses of a flight, newest first (without report body).
An AI analysis with its validated report, usage, cost and versions.
The exact context the model received (JSON; Engineer).
The report as a Markdown file.
Whether AI analysis is enabled, with the model and the team's daily quota.
Usage of the last `days` days (1 to 365, default 30).

put.summary: Replaces the aircraft details. `version` must be the version last read.

post.summary: Queues a new analysis of the flight's processed log (Engineer). Poll the returned run for its result.

get.summary: Analysis runs of a flight, newest first.
A run with its status, counts and the outcome of every rule (applied, not applicable and why, failed).
Findings of a run in time order; filter by minimum severity, category or rule.
The rules of the engine: what each checks, the data it needs and when it does not apply.
Statistics of the last `hours` hours (1 to 720, default 24).

post.summary: Creates an account. Disabled unless `Auth:AllowSelfRegistration` is true.
Exchanges e-mail and password for an access token and a refresh token.
Issues a new token pair from a valid refresh token.

get.summary: Profile of the authenticated user, including system roles and team memberships.
Comments of a flight in time order (deleted ones without text); with `findingId` only those on that finding.

post.summary: Adds a comment (Engineer). With `startUs`/`endUs` it is a note on that part of the flight; with `findingId` it goes on the finding.

put.summary: Edits a comment (its author only). `version` must be the version last read.

delete.summary: Deletes a comment (its author or a project manager); the comment stays in the thread without its text.

patch.summary:
Changes a finding's review (Engineer): status, assignee (an engineer or project manager of the team), flag, and
an optional note that is added as a comment. The review survives re-analysis as long as the rule finds the same time range.

get.summary: Who changed the finding's review and its comments, and when; newest first.
The team's reviewed findings, most recently changed first (filter by assignee, status, flag).
What happened to a flight (uploads, analyses, edits, tags, comments, reviews, exports), newest first.

The team's audit trail (project manager). `action` matches exactly, or as a prefix when it ends with a dot
(`finding.`).

Compares 2 to 6 flights (`ids` repeated): durations, findings and rule results, statistics of normalized
signals, battery, vibration, flight modes and the latest AI report; with notes on what is not directly comparable.
The comparison as a CSV (one column per flight) or JSON file.
The flight as one JSON report: summary, analysis with findings and reviews, events, parameter changes, AI report, comments.
Findings of the latest analysis with review state, as CSV.
All events of the flight as CSV.
Counts, processing state, findings of the latest analyses and the most recent flights of the team.
Lists the signals of a flight: raw fields of the log and normalized signals, with units and statistics.

Values of up to 8 signals (`names` repeated or comma separated) in an optional time range. Long ranges are
reduced to about `maxPoints` points per signal, keeping each bucket's minimum and maximum.
Timeline events (messages, mode changes, arming, failsafes, errors) in time order.
Parameters at log start, firmware defaults (when the log has them) and changes during the flight.
Processing attempts of a log file, newest first, with timing, parser statistics and failure details.

Lists flights with filtering, search, sorting and paging. Dates filter on the flight start time when
it is known, otherwise on the upload time.

put.summary: Updates name, notes and the aircraft link. `version` must be the version last read.

delete.summary: Deletes the flight and its log file records (project manager only).

get.summary: Tags of the team's flights, most used first (at most 200).

post.summary:
Uploads one log file (`multipart/form-data`, field `file`) into the project and creates a flight for it.
The body is streamed: it is never buffered in memory. To upload several files, send one request per file.
The format is detected from the content; the extension must agree (`.ulg` or `.bin`).

parameters.name: aircraftId
parameters.description: Optional aircraft of the same team.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Optional flight name; defaults to the file name.

get.summary: Downloads the original log file.

post.summary: Cancels processing of a queued or running file.
Queues a failed or cancelled file again.

put.summary: Updates a project. The request must carry the version last read; a stale version returns 409.

get.summary: Teams the current user is a member of.

post.summary: Creates a team; the caller becomes its project manager.
Adds a registered user to the team (project manager only).

delete.summary: Removes a member. Members may remove themselves; removing others requires the project manager role.

post.summary: Creates a project in the team (project manager only).
